items.title: Tesla's new partnership: Swedish company Einride to deploy 500 Tesla semi-truck EVs
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) is partnering with Swedish trucking company Einride (ENRD), which is deploying 500 of Tesla's electric semi-trucks. Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman explains the details.

items.title: What does Tesla's Cybercab launch mean for SpaceX's own ambitions?
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) showcased its new Cybercab — a version of its autonomous robotaxi without a steering wheel — ahead of its planned launch in Austin, Texas. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley and Barron's associate editor Al Root to discuss this story and what it could represent for Elon Musk's ambitions for SpaceX.
